description.fun: Lugia knows its own strength, so it hides deep under the sea: a light flutter of its wings can blow down a house, and a full flap could whip up a storm lasting forty days. It once perched on Ecruteak's Brass Tower and moved to the Whirl Islands after the tower burned. It started life as 'Pokémon X', a creature written for the second movie, and was missing from Gold and Silver's 1997 demo.
description.guide: A Psychic- and Flying-type Legendary Pokémon, white and dragon-like, said to be the guardian of the seas, and the mascot of Pokémon Silver and SoulSilver. It can calm or raise storms and lives alone deep in the sea. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: The guardian of the seas, mascot of Pokémon Silver
